narrator.instruct: Excited, wildly expressive comedy narrator. Big reactions, mock horror on the gross bits, gossip-show glee, never calm.

dog.instruct: Flat, deadpan, unimpressed street-wise voice. Slow and bored.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You wake up with a dog's sense of smell.

voice.instruct: Punchy, amazed opening hook, like announcing a superpower.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And WOW, this is a terrible idea.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You can smell your neighbor's breakfast.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Yesterday's pizza.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And your socks?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: OH NO. THEY'RE ALIVE!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You run outside for some fresh air.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: BIG MISTAKE.

voice.instruct: Short, sharp warning, two quick punchy words, no drawn-out vowels.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That tree? It's basically Instagram for dogs.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Max was here. Bella was here.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And Rocky? He posted twelve times!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then suddenly, CHICKEN!

voice.instruct: Starts sneaky, then explodes on CHICKEN.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You follow the smell down the street.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Past three houses.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Around the corner.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And, straight to a trash can.

voice.instruct: Building up, then a deflated letdown on trash can.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There's already a dog there.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He looks at you. You look at him.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He's like,

lines.speaker: dog
lines.text: Bro. Get in line.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that's when you realize,

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Dogs aren't weird. We've just been missing all the gossip!
